## RCA + remediation decision (Option 1: terraform write-only args)

**Root cause (confirmed).** The operator-seeded SSM SecureString secrets used
`value = "CHANGEME"` + `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [value] }`. `ignore_changes`
suppresses the terraform *diff* but not the *refresh*: the AWS provider reads each live
secret value into `attributes.value` on every plan/refresh/import, so 23 secrets landed in
CLEARTEXT in the remote state (S3 `rebar-tfstate-896586841071`, key
`rebar/prod/terraform.tfstate`, SSE-S3 not a CMK), collapsing the SecureString tier to the
state-bucket ACL.

**Approved direction — Option 1 (operator-approved, not re-opened).** Migrate every
SecureString **secret** parameter to terraform write-only arguments `value_wo` +
`value_wo_version`, which the provider by design NEVER persists to state.

**What changed (Gerrit change 2383, NOT submitted).**
- `infra/terraform/ssm.tf` (`rebar_secrets`, 18 slots), `opcert.tf` (`opcert_ed25519_key`),
  `auth_sso.tf` (`cookie_signing_secret`) -> `value_wo` + `value_wo_version = 1`; dropped the
  literal `value`/`ignore_changes = [value]`. Non-secret String params and the
  terraform-GENERATED `opcert_origin_guard` deliberately left as-is.
- `versions.tf` floors raised: Terraform `>= 1.11`, AWS provider `~> 5.79` (satisfied by the
  1.15.8 / 5.100.0 toolchain). `terraform validate` passes.
- New hermetic guard `scripts/check_ssm_secret_state.py` wired into `make lint` (sibling of
  `check_templatefile_escapes.py`) + `tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py`. RED->GREEN
  proven: RED = 6 findings (3 resources x {literal-value, ignore_changes}) against the pre-fix
  tree for the right reason; GREEN after; mutation teeth = reverting one param to
  value+ignore_changes returns it to RED. `make lint` and 83 affected unit tests pass.
- Lockstep consumers updated: `opcert-plan-assertions.sh` assertion (f) and
  `test_opcert_deploy_infra.py` now assert the write-only invariant. Doc refreshes:
  `sso-auth-host.md`, `gerrit-auth-hardening.md`, `g2p-ci-credentials.md`, `mcp-client-pats.md`.

**ADR + runbook.**
- ADR `docs/adr/0105-ssm-secrets-never-in-terraform-state.md` (extends ADR 0008 to "and never
  in terraform state either"; relates to ADR 0046). Index regenerated; `check_adr_numbers.py`
  passes.
- Runbook `infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md` (declare/seed/rotate + the one-time
  state-scrub-and-rotate remediation; cross-links ADR 0105).

**Deferred operator work (PROD mutations — NOT done here).** Task
`gnarly-sinistrous-groundhog` (097b-de23-bf12-4c38), linked `discovered_from` this ticket:
apply the migration, re-seed/rotate the exposed crown-jewels in the same window, verify no
SecureString value in `terraform state pull`, and scrub the historical cleartext from the state
bucket's retained versions (coordinating with the separate rubied MCP-PAT apply). Must run
AFTER change 2383 lands.

**Gate + status.** Plan-review PASS (attested, signed, currency basis file_impact); ticket
claimed and left `in_progress`. Gerrit change **2383**
(Change-Id `I163d9635d026e15934c77f81828242748f72463f`),
https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2383 — deliberately NOT submitted and this
ticket deliberately NOT closed (the real remediation is the deferred operator task; closing is
an operator decision).
